subject: general
question: A western disturbance is the extra-tropical storm that brings rainfall over northwest India during winter. From which ocean does this disturbance originate?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mediterranean Sea**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Mediterranean Sea** is the origin of the western disturbances that bring rainfall over northwest India during winter.
 
• Western disturbances are extra-tropical storms originating in the Mediterranean region, which cause winter precipitation in the Indian subcontinent.</li&g
